title: AIAS Master Inventory and Roadmap
purpose: Create the canonical, dependency-ordered inventory of all recovered AIAS rules, systems, offices, capabilities, programs and future visions before integral materialization continues.
scope: Stable identifiers, classification, lifecycle state, evidence, dependencies, duplicate resolution, chronological waves, lighthouse-project contract and machine-readable release.

requirements.title: Canonical catalog
requirements.statement: The system shall register every recovered concept with a stable identifier, classification, state and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: State honesty
requirements.statement: The system shall distinguish operational, partial, specified, planned, superseded and duplicate concepts.
requirements.rationale: Prevent roadmap ideas from being represented as completed.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Dependency order
requirements.statement: The system shall produce an acyclic dependency graph and chronological execution waves.
requirements.rationale: Enable giant steps without unsafe sequencing.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Evidence reconciliation
requirements.statement: The system shall reconcile declared states with repository paths and report unsupported declarations.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Lighthouse contract
requirements.statement: The system shall define Project Lighthouse 001 as the permanent real consumer of institutional and engineering capabilities.
requirements.rationale: Prevent infrastructure without immediate engineering value.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Auditable release
requirements.statement: The system shall generate JSON, Markdown, dependency, roadmap and checksum-protected release artifacts.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the complete plan across conversations and decades.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
